parse_protobuf_text: parse a protobuf text format string into a protocol buffer message object
merge_protobuf_text: merge a protobuf text format string into a message allowing repeated non-repeated field values
message_to_string: convert a protocol buffer message to a human-readable text format string
message_to_bytes: convert a protocol buffer message to encoded text format bytes
print_message: print a protocol buffer message to an output stream with configurable formatting options
